All good for 11:00. Quick capacity notes (initial recommendation):

- Baseline: request a temporary Dedicated pool equivalent to 1xA100 for the POC day. This gives predictable latency and makes token accounting clean.
- Token budget (initial conservative): 250,000 tokens/day (split: 200k gen / 50k embedding/metrics). See attached estimate for breakdown.
- Rate limits for the load window: provision temporary 10 req/s with burst up to 30 for short duration (15 minutes) — monitor queues and reduce if latency spikes above 400ms p50.
- Fallback policy: if latency >700ms p50, automatically route to a cheaper Hosted variant (with lower concurrency) and notify MonarchAI and account team.

I’ll prepare the quota bump request and list of required whitelisting IPs. Dylan — can you confirm test harness and tooling for the 15-min run? Marissa — deck/agenda looks good, would add a short prompt tuning checklist.
